mentions.name: mcore.systems telecom core network
mentions.description: A fully 3GPP-compliant telecom core network supporting 2G through 5G, built from scratch and now in production. It is interconnected with two MNOs and delivers voice, data, SMS, USSD and other value-added services for its first client, targeting MVNEs and MVNOs.
